```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
```

```{r}
gt(weather)
ggplot(weather)
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
))
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line()
```
